title: Aurelia app manifest (aurelia.app.json)
description: One per app folder (apps/<folder>/aurelia.app.json), or one entry per external site in the root registry.external.json. The hand-written validator in packages/core/src/manifest (validateManifest) enforces this schema plus the cross-field rules noted in each description; scripts/check-manifests.mjs runs it in CI.

id.description: Two-digit app number, e.g. "04". Internal apps use 00-49, external sites 50-99.

slug.description: The folder name without its number prefix.

folder.description: Must equal <id>-<slug>. For internal apps it is the folder under apps/.

shortName.description: Optional short label (Download Center, home-screen name).

url.description: Required for kind external; not allowed for internal apps.

icon.description: Path relative to the app's public/ folder. Required for internal apps.

emoji.description: Optional glyph shown on hub cards.

route.description: Internal apps: /apps/<folder>/ (the hub, 00, is /). Required for internal, not allowed for external.

nativeId.description: Capacitor appId from capacitor.config.ts. Required for internal apps.

emits.description: Event names from EVENT_CATALOG this app publishes.

accepts.description: Event names from EVENT_CATALOG this app subscribes to.

deepLinks.description: Hash prefixes this app handles, without the leading '#', e.g. "ctl=".

storageKeys.description: localStorage keys and IndexedDB names the app owns. Each must start with aurelia.<id>. Keys allow-listed in LEGACY_STORAGE_KEYS only warn until migrated.

dependencies.description: Ids of other apps this one links to or exchanges events with.
